run_mae_pretraining: run the MAE pre-training script with default arguments via python run_pretrain.py
run_pretraining_with_custom_model: run MAE pre-training with a custom model name using the --model flag
run_pretraining_with_output_dir: run MAE pre-training and save checkpoints to a specified output directory
run_pretraining_with_mask_ratio: run MAE pre-training with a custom masking ratio using the --mask_ratio flag
run_pretraining_with_learning_rate: run MAE pre-training with a custom base learning rate using the --blr flag
